frame: minor-league feeds carrying challenges at this level: .cache/game_feeds and .cache/EWAR_T4_ABS_LEDGER/aaa_feeds
values_nothing: no run value, no win value, no rating: a measurement substrate
invariant_note: invariant_ok false marks a feed whose rows do not equal its absChallenges counts; such a feed is excluded from any stability frame. invariant_zone_ok is the same comparison over zone rows only (added after the registration: the 2025 Single-A feeds leave check-swing challenges out of absChallenges)
role_by_side_note: challenge_side is the challenging club's side; role_by_side reads it under the rule that only the batter challenges for the offense and only the pitcher or catcher for the defense. Feeds before 2026 carry no challenger id, so role is unresolved there and role_by_side is the read
